one_line: A creator opens by blowing bubbles that rest on a sock-covered hand, promises a three-ingredient recipe for bubbles that do not pop, shows the recipe steps on a table, then a child blowing bubbles with a straw, a safety note about wearing a glove or sock, and a share ask.

hook.visual: A woman in a beige top looks into the camera and blows a soap bubble; a bubble floats in front of her face while a white sock covers the hand held in the foreground (frames 0.0 to 6.0 s).
hook.on_screen_text: אתם לא מאמינים 😱😱 בועות עמידות וקופצניות שלא מתפוצצות ! (You won't believe it: durable, bouncy bubbles that don't pop!)
hook.first_spoken_line: אתם לא מאמינים בועות עמידות וקופצניות שלא מתפוצצות משלושה מרכיבים פשוטים שיש לכם בבית, אתם חייבים לנסות את זה גם. (You won't believe it, durable bouncy bubbles that don't pop, from three simple ingredients you have at home, you have to try this too.)
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Inferred: the result (a bubble hanging in front of a smiling face and resting on a sock) is on screen from 0.0 s, with a 'you won't believe it' line and shock emojis. Bubbles that do not pop are a visual surprise, and the recipe is promised right after.

beats.observed: Creator blows bubbles toward the camera; bubbles rest on or float near a white sock worn on her hand, which is held up to the lens. She smiles and talks to camera.
beats.spoken: The creator says (Whisper): bubbles that are durable and bouncy and don't pop, from three simple ingredients you have at home, you must try it.
beats.on_screen_text: אתם לא מאמינים 😱😱 / בועות עמידות וקופצניות שלא מתפוצצות ! (You won't believe it / durable, bouncy bubbles that don't pop!)

beats.observed: Same talking shot; a bubble drifts in front of her face and onto the sock.
beats.spoken: Continuation of the opening line: three simple ingredients, you have to try it too.
beats.on_screen_text: משלושה מרכיבים פשוטים שיש לכם בבית ! אתם חייבים לנסות את זה גם ! (From three simple ingredients you have at home! You have to try this too!)

beats.observed: Cut to a wooden table and a white ramekin; a white spoon pours warm water, then a spoon of yellow dish soap, then a spoon of sugar into the bowl. A child in an orange jersey is partly visible at the top edge of the frame.
beats.spoken: Whisper: mix in a cup or bowl four spoons of warm water, one spoon of dish soap and two spoons of sugar (Whisper garbles 'בכוס או קערה' as 'בקוס וקערה').
beats.on_screen_text: מערבבים בכוס או קערה 4 כפות של מים חמימים / כף אחת של סבון כלים / ושתי כפות של סוכר (Mix in a cup or bowl 4 spoons of warm water / one spoon of dish soap / and two spoons of sugar)

beats.observed: A child in an orange football jersey blows through a straw; a large bubble hangs at the end of the straw and then sits on a grey sock-covered hand held in from the camera side. The child holds the straw and appears to be smiling at 18.0 s.
beats.spoken: Whisper (garbled): let it rest half an hour, dip a straw and blow, see the magic.
beats.on_screen_text: תנו לזה לנוח חצי שעה / תטבלו קשית ותנשפו ותראו איזה קסם ! (Let it rest half an hour / Dip a straw and blow and see the magic!)

beats.observed: Same child with a straw and a bubble on the grey sock; the sock covers the forearm and hand reaching into frame.
beats.spoken: Whisper: note that you must put a glove or sock on the hand.
beats.on_screen_text: * שימו לב שחובה לשים על היד כפפה או גרב (* Note that you must put a glove or sock on your hand)

beats.observed: Back to the opening setup: the creator smiling with a bubble in front of her mouth and a sock on her hand.
beats.spoken: Whisper: share with whoever has to try it.
beats.on_screen_text: שתפו עם מי שחייב לנסות ! 😍 (Share with whoever has to try it!)

payoff: The result (bubbles that do not pop) is shown at 0.0 s; the full recipe lands at 7.0-12.5 s; the child's straw-blowing demo at 12.5-18.4 s; the safety note at 16.3-18.4 s.
cta: Share with whoever has to try it (on screen at 19.5 s, spoken at the end per Whisper). The caption also asks viewers to mark if they liked it and share.
share_or_comment_trigger: Inferred: a three-ingredient recipe using dish soap and sugar that kids can play with is a saveable weekend activity, and the explicit 'share with whoever has to try it' ask names a person to tag. The 396 comments might include questions about the recipe, which is not verifiable from the data.
why_it_worked: 2,146,352 views against a median of 37,886 (outlier_x 56.7): the opening image of an unpopped bubble is a strong visual hook for a 20-second clip (observed and inferred).
like_rate 0.93% is a healthy ratio for a 2.1M-view reel, which suggests many viewers valued the recipe enough to like or save it (inferred from meta.json).
Each step has its own one-line burned-in caption and a 1-2 second shot, so the clip is easy to follow without sound and teaches the entire recipe in under 6 seconds (observed).
paid_signal: no | like_rate 0.93% is well above the 0.3% flag and the account has a mid-size baseline (median 37,886 views); no sign of a boost.

solo_route.how: 1) Film a 3-second face-to-camera opening in which the finished result is already on screen, with a short line about what it is (here: the printed LumeBook with the child's face on the cover). 2) Film the steps as separate 2-second table shots with a single burned-in caption each (upload photo, free preview, printed book). 3) End with the creator returning to the opening shot and a one-line share ask in text. 4) Put the full recipe or details in the caption as a list, the way this video does, so people can save it.
solo_route.needs: Nothing for a version without children. If a child is shown, a relative's child with written parental consent.

lumebook_version.hook_he: אתם לא מאמינים מה יצא מתמונה אחת של הילד, בשלושה צעדים (You won't believe what came out of one photo of the child, in three steps)
lumebook_version.concept: Open with the finished LumeBook cover in the creator's hands and a reaction at 0.0 s, then three one-line steps (upload a photo, see the free preview, order the printed book) each on its own 2-second shot, and end with a text line share ask such as 'שלחו למי שחייב לראות', with the details in the caption.

evidence_notes: Observed: the creator talking and blowing bubbles; sock on the hand in the opening and closing shots; the three recipe steps with matching text; a child in an orange jersey with a straw; the safety line. I read the small on-screen text in single frames at 4.5, 7.5, 13.5 and 16.5 s. Spoken: Whisper is mostly accurate (it produced the full opening line, the recipe amounts and the share line) but garbled 'בכוס או קערה', 'תנו לזה לנוח', 'תטבלו קשית' and 'גרב' (heard as 'גל'); I used the clean on-screen text for quotes. Not verified: that the recipe actually makes bubbles that do not pop, and the safety effect of the sock; nothing in the frames proves it. The caption says the child must be supervised by an adult. The identities of the woman and the child are not stated; no one is identified. The account is a creator profile (name in meta.json), not a brand, so made_by is left as unclear.
